p1_findings.observation: Arm C PRE requests declared validation seeds 2027 and 2028, but the corresponding TrainingRawRunOutputV2 and RawResultEnvelopeV2 records both report seed 2026.
p1_findings.root_cause: PilotTrainingLauncherV1 used the profile ordinary seed instead of CandidateExecutionBindingV3.search_seed; result closure also received the ordinary seed.
p1_findings.scientific_consequence: The supposed independent validation observations are duplicate-seed executions and cannot satisfy the Guard validation semantics.
p1_findings.repair_requirement: Bind worker command, raw output and result closure to the final candidate execution binding; persist an Arm-private ExecutionSeedBindingV1 record and audit task requirement through worker result.

p1_findings.observation: Every V24 execution containing BPR_TAIL_REWEIGHT returned NDCG@10 0.0057 across A, B and C.
p1_findings.root_cause: The padding item's zero popularity was transformed with rsqrt into infinity; normalization by a global infinite mean collapsed real-item weights.
p1_findings.scientific_consequence: The failure is common-substrate implementation behavior, not evidence for or against the Research Line; it materially distorts all arm means.
p1_findings.repair_requirement: Exclude the padding item from normalization, require finite positive real-item weights and run a fixed full-recipe tail-reweight canary before the next Pilot freeze.

p2_findings.observation: All five normal Research executions selected falsification_designer proposals even though all four Producers made five calls each.
p2_findings.diagnosis: Provider-supplied utility features are only partially deterministically calibrated, so cross-role self-scoring can dominate opportunity allocation. Provider means were composer 0.836/0.838/0.836, lineage 0.758/0.794/0.690, falsification 0.862/0.920/0.818 and frontier 0.782/0.858/0.844 for useful-signal/information-gain/frontier-potential.
p2_findings.repair_requirement: Use a versioned, deterministic score-aware minimum-opportunity acquisition layer shared by B and C; do not change effect thresholds or the frozen V19 coefficients in place.

p2_findings.observation: B consumed rounds 2 and 4 on identical BPR_MF root controls and C consumed round 4 on the same root control.
p2_findings.diagnosis: The matched-control planner checked only a proposal parent and did not reuse an already completed exact root comparator.
p2_findings.repair_requirement: Allow reuse only within the same Arm for an exact mechanism-program digest, protocol digest and observation seed with a successful metric; never reuse cross-Arm results.

p2_findings.observation: The supervisor failed after all training closed because the final neutral audit expected exit_receipt_digest while the Lab receipt schema exposes receipt_digest; several behavioral reports therefore were not written even though immutable database snapshots were complete.
p2_findings.diagnosis: Critical behavioral projections were persisted only at finalization.
p2_findings.repair_requirement: Persist current-byte Arm-private and association-free neutral behavioral checkpoints after every closed triplet, then make final audit an aggregation of those canonical records.

required_requalification_before_freeze: execution seed binding unit and full-chain tests
deterministic Producer opportunity coverage tests across all route/task/result branches and randomized schedules
M6I six-order and at-least-100-seed synthetic closure

outcome_use_boundary.allowed: V24 is used only to diagnose implementation, protocol, acquisition and observability defects.
forbidden: selecting the next seed from observed arm outcomes
importing V24 SearchMemory, Meta state, frontier state or candidate results
